name: smwpatches-alternate-changed-cape-smash
title: Alternate/Changed Cape Smash
description:
This patch will change the cape smash. I thought it was too powerful in the original game- So now, a cape smash causes carriable items (or enemies, I.E. Goomba and Koopa) to fly into the air, but other sprites to stay on the ground (can be changed with a define). Additionally, when mario smashes the ground, he is bounced back, flying, into the air.

So it's more of a cape "bounce," now, I suppose (can also be changed).

Moderator's note: pretty fun patch that now works with SA-1 as well.
